summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the Central de Carrocería y Pintura app. Backend: 24/24 pytest cases passed covering auth (401/403/200), settings (mail_configured false), users CRUD (admin only), photos upload/fetch/validation, entries create/validate/preview-no-folio/list-search/filters/estado toggle/update/pdf/send/404/estado-invalid. Frontend: full 7-step wizard flow (validation, draft reload persistence, inventory counters +/-, mark-all/clear, damage chip + note, gallery photo upload, summary with edit buttons, PDF preview pages render, confirm) ending in Success screen with folio and mail-status-banner data-status=no_configurado. Inventory search by placas works, estado toggle to Entregado removes row from default view, detail view opens, edit flow -> 'Cambios guardados' shown and edit persisted. Settings shows 'Correo: no configurado', taller data saved and header reflects it, allowed user add/remove works. Mobile 390x844 and tablet 1024x768 both render correctly.

issues: Uses browser native <input type=date> (mm/dd/yyyy in default locale) rather than a localized date picker component. App is Spanish but native picker shows English month/day order on English locale.

critical_code_review_comments: settings-nombre/telefono/direccion/nota-legal data-testids are placed on the Field wrapper div, not the inner <input>. Automated tests must use selector '[data-testid="settings-nombre"] input' to interact. Consider moving data-testid onto the <input> itself in components/Field.jsx for cleaner selectors.
server.py uses on_event startup/shutdown (deprecated in FastAPI); migrate to lifespan context manager when upgrading.
mail.photos: no cleanup when fotos are removed from an entry on PUT/DELETE - orphaned photo docs will accumulate.
No DELETE endpoint for entries - admins cannot remove bad entries except via DB.
preview endpoint builds a full PDF (expensive) on every call; consider caching or lightweight preview for large entries.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (wizard, draft persistence, inventory search/filter/toggle, edit flow, settings, user CRUD)

test_credentials: Created ephemeral test users via mongosh: admin test.user.adm.*@example.com (token test_session_admin_*) and staff test.user.stf.*@example.com (token test_session_staff_*). All cleaned up after tests.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted test entries (TEST_* prefix); db.counters folio reset; test allowed_emails/users/sessions removed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run with env vars ADMIN_TOK, STAFF_TOK, ADMIN_EM, STAFF_EM, REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, MONGO_URL, DB_NAME). The test uses pytest-xdist with 2 workers. Create fresh test users per /app/auth_testing.md. For UI tests, set cookie 'session_token' on domain entrada-rapida-autos.preview.emergentagent.com. Note: Field component wraps input; data-testid is on wrapper (use ' input' child selector).
